messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: gpu-pool-use-south-east queue depth > 5k, throttling observed across hosted inference. autoscaler attempts failing. paging oncall.
chen (oncall): I’m on it. seeing large queue growth and 429s from frontend traces. rolling up quick health checks. :eyes:
sre-bot: Pager: high-priority. affected customers showing increased latency and token throttles.
chen (oncall): quick snapshot: pool utilization 98%, 42 nodes reporting MIG fragments, autoscaler reports placement failures. trying a manual scale request to add 8 GPUs to Dedicated burst.
maya (eng-runtime): timeline: autoscaler made 3 attempts in last 10m, each failed with "PlacementImpossible: insufficient contiguous MIG slices". scheduler logs show binpack rejections due to mismatched MIG instance types.
olivia: Are we hitting cloud quota or actual placement fragmentation? Which is the blocker?
chen (oncall): not quota. cloud capacity available but our scheduler can't find compatible packing because many nodes are sliced as 1g.5gb and pods request 2g slices. Stranded capacity ~ 30%-40% on cluster.
kyle (ops-lead): That explains why manual scale doesn't help — new GPUs come with different default MIG sizing and autoscaler respects exact slice matching.
maya (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigation options: 1) enable emergency-rebalance controller to consolidate small-slice workloads onto fewer nodes, 2) temporarily allow pod migration to different MIG sizes by relaxing instance-type constraints, 3) evict/scale down low-priority batch jobs. Doing (1) + (3) now.
chen (oncall): executing eviction of low-priority queues and enabling consolidation. running drain on low-util nodes.
chen (oncall): ```bash
# drain low-priority nodes
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
maya (eng-runtime): started consolidation job: binpack-rebalance v2 -> will attempt to pack small MIG slices first. Watch for transient OOMs.
sre-bot: Note: enabling consolidation will increase scheduling churn. Recommend temporary increase of fallback_slo for affected customers.
sam (customer-success): Heads-up — I’m already getting messages from a couple customers about degraded throughput. I’ll send an update saying we have an active mitigation and ETA ~30-60m.
chen (oncall): manual scale succeeded for Dedicated burst but scheduler still can't place some medium requests due to MIG sizing mismatch. Initiating targeted MIG resize on a subset of new nodes to create 2g slices.
maya (eng-runtime): command applied to nodepool gpu-pool-south-east-2: set MIG profile to 2g for 6 nodes. This will disrupt any running vGPU instances for ~2m each as driver reconfigures. Doing in waves.
chen (oncall): logs during reconfig: 
```
scheduler: assign pod request=2g -> node gpu-node-88: MIG mismatch -> failed
scheduler: after resize attempt, assign pod request=2g -> node gpu-node-88: success
```
olivia: Good. Any risk of cascading failures? If resizes fail, we should roll back. Keep customer-impacted route throttling in place.
kyle (ops-lead): Also temporarily bumped autoscaler tolerance to avoid oscillation: smoothing window -> 5m, min-scale-delay -> 3m.
maya (eng-runtime): After first wave of resizes and eviction, queue dropped from 5200 -> 1100 in 18 minutes. Throttles are down but still some 429s for heavy customers.
chen (oncall): running final consolidation. will open a short maintenance note. sam, please post to affected customers with ETA update.
sam (customer-success): Posted an update: "We're mitigating an infrastructure scheduling issue impacting inference throughput in S-E region. Engineers actively consolidating workloads and resizing GPU slices. Expect gradual recovery over the next hour."
zara (oncall-night): I’ll be taking over at handoff in 30m. Anything you want me to watch specifically?
chen (oncall): watch binpack-rebalance jobs and autoscaler logs for "PlacementImpossible" and keep an eye on stranded_capacity metric. If queue growth > 2k again, escalate to emergency procure (kyle).
zara (oncall-night): ack. I’ll also leave a runbook step to toggle consolidation back off after stable 30m.
olivia: Post-mortem action items: - Improve autoscaler placement heuristics to consider flexible MIG matching - Add proactive defragmentation job during low-traffic windows - Add metric alert for stranded_capacity > 15% - Doc fallback: temporary MIG resize playbook and customer communication templates.
maya (eng-runtime): filing a ticket for autoscaler heuristics + prototype work for dynamic MIG relaxation.
chen (oncall): last check: queue 350, token errors dropping to baseline. marking incident as mitigating. handing off to zara for monitoring and post-incident writeup. :thumbsup:
zara (oncall-night): taking over. leaving channel open for 1h then will create postmortem draft.
sre-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigating -> monitoring.
